dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-selkies:ubunturesolute

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG PHOTOCRAFT_RELEASE
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thelamer"

# title
ENV TITLE="Craft Apps" \
    NO_FULL=true \
    SELKIES_DESKTOP=true \
    PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=true

RUN \
  echo "**** add icon ****" && \
  curl -o \
    /usr/share/selkies/www/icon.png \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linuxserver/docker-templates/master/linuxserver.io/img/artcraft-logo.png && \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  add-apt-repository ppa:xtradeb/apps && \
  apt-get update && \
  apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    caja \
    chromium \
    chromium-l10n \
    libegl1 \
    xdg-desktop-portal \
    xdg-desktop-portal-gtk && \
  echo "**** install photocraft ****" && \
  if [ -z ${PHOTOCRAFT_RELEASE+x} ]; then \
    PHOTOCRAFT_RELEASE=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/storytold/photocraft/releases/latest" \
      | jq -r '.tag_name'); \
  fi && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/photocraft.deb -L \
    "https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/releases/download/${PHOTOCRAFT_RELEASE}/photocraft-$(echo ${PHOTOCRAFT_RELEASE} | sed 's/^v//g')-linux-x86_64.deb" && \
  echo "**** install craft suite ****" && \
  for APP in designcraft effectcraft figcraft filmcraft lightcraft pdfcraft vectorcraft; do \
    APP_RELEASE=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/storytold/${APP}/releases/latest" \
      | jq -r '.tag_name') && \
    curl -o \
      /tmp/${APP}.deb -L \
      "https://github.com/storytold/${APP}/releases/download/${APP_RELEASE}/${APP}-$(echo ${APP_RELEASE} | sed 's/^v//g')-linux-x86_64.deb"; \
  done && \
  apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    /tmp/*.deb && \
  echo "**** application tweaks ****" && \
  mv \
    /usr/bin/chromium \
    /usr/bin/chromium-real && \
  sed -i \
    's/^Icon=.*/Icon=system-file-manager-symbolic/' \
    /usr/share/applications/caja.desktop && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apt-get autoclean && \
  rm -rf \
    /config/.cache \
    /tmp/* \
    /usr/share/applications/caja-autorun-software.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/caja-browser.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/caja-computer.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/caja-file-management-properties.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/caja-folder-handler.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/caja-home.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/debian-uxterm.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/debian-xterm.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/footclient.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/foot-server.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/mate-about.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/mate-color-select.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/mate-network-scheme.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/st.desktop \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/tmp/*

# add local files
COPY /root /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 3001

VOLUME /config

notes.upstream:
## What's Changed
* Add editable arrowheads to Line tool (#6408) by @superplay2021 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9259
* Integration batch 11: 9 ATN PRs on main by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10535
* Prefer an installed pattern ID over a colliding name in ATN import by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/7642
* Actions: read .atn step names in the code page Photoshop wrote them in (#6743) by @regexer in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8327
* feat(actions): import recorded Camera Raw Filter steps as filter.cameraRaw by @FinnNk in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8714
* Refuse exporting an adjustment edit that names its layer to .atn by @mercuryVM in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8736
* fix(atn): import Photoshop's string class for Vibrance adjustment Sets by @jturnbach in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8858
* fix(engine): refuse strict .atn export of a partial Levels edit (#8530) by @marshiyar in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10417
* ATN export: Stroke steps write the settings they leave at default (#8303) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10424
* Actions panel: New Set, and New Action records into the selected set (#7535) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10459
* test(atn): add native parser matrix and contract fixtures by @denstu473 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/7561
* Reuse large buffers so returning freed memory to the OS doesn't slow filters (#10479) by @wanikhawar in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10514
* Linux: return memory of closed documents to the system (#8743) by @wanikhawar in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10515
* Format: take the .pcraft envelope from craft-pcraft-format by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10724
* TIFF: open YCbCr images as RGB (#10316) by @Yuki-init in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10319
* Enable font-free GNOME/Wayland controls for system title bars by @danielmigueltejedor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/6266
* Integration batch 12: 14 Actions PRs on main by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10776
* Load every selected Actions file by @yoriswind in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10601
* Import color component selections from Photoshop actions by @yoriswind in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10616
* Map Stylize and Pixelate action events by @yoriswind in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10618
* Map Render filter steps in Photoshop actions by @yoriswind in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10620
* Actions: map Photoshop's newer-feature steps (Oil Paint, Smart Sharpen, Focus Area, Sky, Remove Background) (#10610) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10627
* Map selection, clipboard and layer-operation ATN events by @yoriswind in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10628
* Actions: map Photoshop's Split Channels, Merge Spot Channel, Trap and Match Color steps (#10609) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10630
* Actions: map Photoshop's De-Interlace, NTSC, HSB/HSL, Custom, Average and matting steps (#10607) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10631
* Actions: map all 47 Filter Gallery effects (#10592) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10632
* Actions: preserve settings in mapped ATN events by @yoriswind in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10702
* Actions: restore command options for ATN playback by @yoriswind in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10704
* Read Photoshop Actions version 12 descriptors by @yoriswind in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10743
* Support recorded layer, document and layer comp references by @yoriswind in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10753
* Actions: map Photoshop's Distort filter steps (Pinch, Polar Coordinates, Spherize, Twirl, Wave, ZigZag) (#10605) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10629
